rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone showing no mercy or pity.

example.english: That executioner was remorseless toward the prisoners.
example.traditional: 嗰個劊子手對犯人毫不留情，真係無情。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 kui2 zi2 sau2 deoi3 faan6 jan4 hou4 bat1 lau4 cing4 zan1 hai6 mou4 cing4

rows.note: Use this specifically when the person shows no remorse after doing something wrong.

example.english: They were remorseless even after being caught stealing someone else’s money.
example.traditional: 佢偷咗人哋啲錢，畀人捉到之後仲一啲冇悔意。
example.jyutping: keoi5 tau1 zo2 jan4 dei6 di1 cin4 bei2 jan4 zuk1 dou3 zi1 hau6 zung6 jat1 di1 mou5 fui3 ji3

rows.note: Use this when someone refuses to stop or give up and keeps pressing on.

example.english: Even after losing the lawsuit, they were remorseless and kept coming to argue with me every day.
example.traditional: 佢輸咗場官司都唔肯罷休，仲日日上門搵我理論。
example.jyutping: keoi5 syu1 zo2 coeng4 gun1 si1 dou1 m4 hang2 baa6 jau1 zung6 jat6 jat6 soeng5 mun4 wan2 ngo5 lei5 leon6
